leaks.description: C-0007 gets an extra 18 points of discount on every Valves line, below its tier floor.
C-0042 is discounted 32% on everything: far above its tier's peers and deeper than any tier's schedule.
Lines under $100 list carry a flat $15.00 freight that is never billed back.
Twenty thin-margin Valves SKUs keep their price after a 12% supplier cost rise on 2025-11-01.
C-0123 is assigned tier T40 but billed at the T05 discount.
